title: Scaled concentration threshold
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer, let $\lambda>0$, and let $t\in\mathbb R$. If $(\sqrt{2e/\lambda})^k\le t$, then $t>0$ and $\lambda t^{2/k}/e\ge2$.
replaced: Let $k>0$ be an integer, $\lambda>0$, and $t\ge(\sqrt{2e/\lambda})^k$. Then $t>0$ and $\lambda t^{2/k}/e\ge2$.
